critical_code_review_comments: AdminSettings.jsx is 1163 lines — recommend splitting each tab's Card + the two Danger cards into separate files (e.g., BrandingCard.jsx, FinanceCard.jsx, ForceLogoutCard.jsx) to stay under the 700-line file guideline.

Global save button always sends the full settings payload (branding+finance+referrals+support) irrespective of which tab was touched — fine for correctness but a granular dirty-field diff would reduce write amplification.
